Local journalism and commentary
fields.description: Issue includes local humor columns ("Little Geraldine"), civic satire and commentary on Miami-area development and politics, and extensive entertainment and advertising content. Notable items include a hole-by-hole satirical "survey" of the Dade County golf course; coverage and promotion of Hialeah racing and Miami Beach nightlife; notices and ads for performances and exhibitions (including Suzanne Lenglen at the Biscayne Fronton); and editorial-style discussion of gambling/racing, prohibition enforcement, and local civic affairs.
